design: existing 20 paired 9/29-stone puzzles; distance-balanced choices (target + equal-distance + farther + 2 nearer); same choices; compact vs code-prepaired moves; common task and coordinate rules; exploratory comparison, no fresh heldout claim

point.instructions: White to move on a 15x15 gomoku board. Which candidate empty coordinate completes five white stones in a consecutive horizontal, vertical or diagonal line and wins immediately? Choose that coordinate. Coordinates use columns a-o from left to right and rows 1-15 from bottom to top. `moves` is an ordered array of consecutive move pairs. Within each pair, the first coordinate is black and the second is white. An unpaired final coordinate is black.

White to move on a 15x15 gomoku board. Which candidate empty coordinate completes five white stones in a consecutive horizontal, vertical or diagonal line and wins immediately? Each move is a letter a-o followed by a row 1-15 (1 at the bottom). Black plays first, then colours alternate.
